details:
Dear VRChat Development Team,

Thank you for your continued work on VRChat. I would like to submit a feature request aimed at improving user experience, transparency, and fairness within instances.

■ Requested Feature

A system that allows users to see how their avatar is currently being displayed from the perspective of other users within the same instance.

Specifically, it would be helpful to know:

Whether the avatar is being shown as an impostor due to Safety settings

Whether shaders or materials are being simplified or replaced

Whether certain avatar components are hidden due to Performance Rank or Safety settings

Whether the avatar is being replaced with a fallback model (e.g., a simplified robot model with missing legs)

■ Background and Rationale

Fairness in Game Worlds

In some game worlds, modifying local avatar display settings can unintentionally create one-sided advantages.

Without a way to confirm how others are seeing your avatar, it is difficult to verify or prevent such situations.

Prevention of Communication Mismatch

If an avatar is not displayed correctly to others:

Expressions and avatar gimmicks may not be visible

Outfit details or visual effects may not appear as intended

This can lead to misunderstandings and communication issues.

■ Expected Benefits

Improved fairness in competitive or game-based worlds

Reduction of user conflicts and confusion

Better testing and verification for avatar creators and event organizers

Enhanced clarity and trust in social interactions

A feature that increases transparency in how avatars are rendered across users would significantly strengthen both community trust and overall experience.

Thank you for your consideration.
title: Request for a Feature to View How My Avatar Appears to Other Users
